contract: the DVD subpicture cases whose FFmpeg result depends on the target, decoded and folded as subtitle-dvd decodes and folds them: cases the reference flags because they reach a C library result that differs between 32-bit ARM and AArch64 for the same arguments (harness/reference_subtitles_host.h)
each case is pinned per target from that target's own reference run, with the reference's flag; a case passes when the candidate, the reference and the target's pin agree
the decoder uses fixed 32-bit bounds for text fields on every target, matching the native 32-bit ARM observations
preparation outside the timed operation: open the input, select the subpicture stream and its configuration, and copy its packets in demux order

one timed operation: create and open the decoder with the stream's configuration, packet time base and options (a decoder that refuses to open folds as no subtitles and the word 2^64 - 1 in both workers), decode every prepared packet with one call each, drain, fold every output subtitle and free it, free the decoder

open_policies.policy: A palette field beyond 32 bits saturates as a 32-bit unsigned long does
open_policies.undecided: ISO C section 7.22.1.4 paragraph 8: strtoul returns ULONG_MAX for a value out of range, and ULONG_MAX is the implementation's; DvdConfig documents fixed 32-bit fields. Neither build of the reference departs from C; their results differ.
open_policies.rule: Saturates 1122334455 and gives white (0xffffff), the fold the 32-bit ARM reference pins.
open_policies.reference_rule: On AArch64 the 64-bit unsigned long keeps the value and its low 32 bits give 0x334455.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule

open_policies.policy: A canvas dimension beyond 32 bits refuses the canvas
open_policies.undecided: ISO C sections 6.3.1.3 and 7.22.1.4 paragraph 8: strtol saturates at the implementation's long range and narrowing an out-of-range value to int is implementation-defined; DvdConfig requires a positive bounded canvas.
open_policies.rule: Refuses the width 4294968016 and the height -4294966816 when opening the decoder, as the 32-bit ARM reference does (no subtitles, word 2^64 - 1).
open_policies.reference_rule: On AArch64 the 64-bit long keeps the values, their low 32 bits give 720 by 480, and it opens that canvas.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule

open_policies.policy: A delay field beyond 32 bits saturates before forming the time offset
open_policies.undecided: ISO C section 7.22.1.4 paragraph 8: strtol saturates at the implementation's long range; the VobSub delay field is read as a 32-bit long.
open_policies.rule: Saturates the delay at -2147483648 or 2147483647 before computing cue times, as the 32-bit ARM reference does.
open_policies.reference_rule: On AArch64 the 64-bit long keeps the low 32 bits and places the cues at other times.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule
